question: A community centre counts its bookings in minutes and puts them on the wall chart in hours. The centre had 119 mugs in its kitchen, and a donation added 66 more. A street party then borrowed 109 mugs and never brought them back. A charity shop gave the centre 71 mugs, and a cafe donated 74. A dozen teapots sit on the top shelf. How many mugs are in the kitchen?

A bakery counts its proving time in minutes and writes it in the diary in hours. On Monday morning the bakery had 102 crates, and each crate holds 4 loaves. During the afternoon 318 loaves were sold. In the evening a second bake added 10 loaves. The loaves that were left were shared equally among the bakery's 4 shops. How many loaves went to one shop?

Mira picked 101 apples from her tree. She gave 65 of them to the village fete. Her uncle then brought her 33 apples from his own orchard. She used 65 apples to make chutney, and a neighbour later gave her 60 more. Mira now has more apples than her brother Sami has. How many apples does Mira have?

On Monday morning a nursery had 108 trays of lettuce, and a grower delivered 60 more before lunch. In the afternoon the trays were counted, and each tray holds 7 seedlings. In the evening 275 seedlings were sold at the gate, and the next morning a supermarket took 677. A customer then returned 5 seedlings. Marta sold more seedlings that week than her colleague Bram did. How many seedlings are at the nursery?

A canoe club had 58 paddles in its shed, and a grant paid for 70 more. A flood then damaged 116 paddles beyond repair. The club bought enough paddles to make the number in the shed 2 times as large, and a merger with another club made it 2 times as large again. Each paddle is stored with 7 spare bolts. All of the bolts were shared equally among the shed's 6 tool boxes. The club has 90 members. How many bolts are in one tool box?

A wholesaler had 222 sacks of onions, and a farm delivered 38 more. A restaurant chain then bought 119 sacks. Each sack still in the warehouse holds 9 onions. A grower later dropped off 56 loose onions. Ana holds more sacks than her competitor Luis does, and a dozen forklifts work in the yard. How many onions are in the warehouse?

On Monday morning a paper mill had 184 bales of pulp, and 72 bales were sent to another mill. In the afternoon each remaining bale was pressed into 7 rolls, and every roll was cut into 4 reams. In the evening 286 reams were damaged by water, and the next day 2277 reams were sold to a printer. Each ream that is left will be cut into 7 pads of paper. The mill employs 130 people. How many pads of paper will the mill make?
